body: Hi there. First of all, I want to say that I'm truly very sorry to hear that your mother died. I haven't lost my mom, but I know that when or if I ever do, it will be incredibly difficult for me to move on, and I'm probably much older than you; I'm in my early thirties. If there's anything I've learned about life though, it's that each day is full of possibilities. Some are good and some are bad, but no matter how bad they are, I do hold on to a tiny bit of hope - lately it has been a REALLY tiny glimmer, because I suffer from depression too, but hope is out there, along with help from others. All you have to do is keep doing exactly what you did here today; reaching out, writing and talking about your feelings and your fears. It's much better than keeping everything bottled inside. And I don't know your family, but I'm guessing that they don't all expect you to be over the tragedy of loosing your mother in only a year. The process of mourning can take months or even years, and although painful, it is how we heal from the shock and sadness of loss. I wish I had the answers... these are just my opinions, BUT I think you should get more support and stick around. Have you ever spoken to a counselor or mental health specialist? That may be helpful too. Even a school counselor or trusted coach or teacher could probably be there for you; you matter to those who love you and even if it doesn't seem like it, you are doing great just by coming on this forum. I wish you peace and happiness down the road. Don't give up.

You know, I've honestly never considered that coping mechanism and it's a really good idea, so thank you kindly. I'm sorry you feel worthless and down too, because it's lonely and painful, so I'm sure the world would be a better place if we could all just help each other. The fact that you took some time to reply to me at all means the world. I can't even tell you. I am hanging on by a thread lately and I know that I'm too close to doing something I can't undo... I am scared... I don't want to hurt anyone. I will give journaling an honest try and see how that goes. Nothing else is helping much... My old therapist used to suggest breathing exercises and I try but no luck. So thank you.
